page.layout: One page of text, running head at top with page number at right; main text block in the centre; marginal note at right beside the second line of the text; woodcut ornament below the text. No text in the lower margins.

main_text.p: non nisi paucos nunc seruandos restare, præ multitudine eorum, qui seruati sunt primis illis temporibus ad prædicationem Apostolorum. Quod si tectum est Euangelium Christi, rectum est ijs, qui pereunt, vt ait Apostolus. Ergo quòd tam pauci nunc tam difficulter credant,id quidem arguit multos esse, quibus sit pereundum, vtpote destinatos iam olim ad certum exitium: à quo petimus vt liberet suos omnes Deus, per Iesum Christum Dominum nostrum. Amen.2. Cor. 4. 3.
main_text.head: FINIS.

page.notes: Marginal note at right reads "2. Cor. 4.3." beside the line "Euangelium". The woodcut ornament below FINIS is not transcribed. Faint show-through of the reverse page is visible in the lower half and is omitted. The line "Quod si tectum est Euangelium" is set with a printed hyphen at line end in "Euange-lium" and "Apo-stolus", "Ie-sum", "Domi-num", "li-beret", reproduced as whole words.
